MAINTENANCE
Jul 28, 2026
SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH MAINTENANCE - JULY 30, 2026

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch maintenance starting on Thursday, July 30, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 10:00 PM AEST). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 8 hours, concluding around 1:00 PM PDT (4:00 PM EDT / 10:00 PM CEST / 6:00 AM AEST July 31).

Times:

Thursday, July 30, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 1:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 6:00 AM July 31

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.270.2.0.
Monthly Windows Update.
List of issues fixed will be updated after maintenance has been completed.

items.title: maintenanceJul 28, 2026v.270 Known IssuesHere you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.270 - Ride the Lightning update.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Jul 28, 2026
V.270 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.270 - Ride the Lightning update:

KNOWN ISSUES
Ride or Die
To ensure fair gameplay for all players, we will be making the following balance changes with the July 30, 2026 maintenance:
HP for bosses in Ride or Die will be increased as clear times were too short to determine appropriate ranking placement.
The Ride or Die timer will now start when the boss appears to reduce the impact of ping on ranking results.
10-second re-entry cooldown will be added to prevent repeated entries for better results. This is to mitigate luck based factors on re-entry.
Week 2 boss challenges will be temporarily unavailable from July 29, 2026 12:00 AM UTC - July 30, 2026 (after maintenance). We apologize for the inconvenience.
The Ride or Die Coin Shop will be temporarily unavailable until further notice.
The Operation: Dive Record Shop will be temporarily unavailable until further notice.
Sol Erda Fragment x10 Coupons are temporarily disabled until further notice.
The unintended Sol Erda Fragment x10 Coupons that were claimed in the Operation Dive Record Shop will be retrieved at a later date.
Princess Sakuno's Blessing and the Twilight Bloom V Cores appear as if they are able to level to 50.
This is a visual bug and performance for these V Cores have not changed.
This will be fixed in the next scheduled maintenance.
RESOLVED ISSUES
July 28, 2026
Resolved an issue where the Operation: Dive Research Records was not resetting properly, preventing players from claiming the 500/1000 Record rewards.
July 23, 2026
Resolved an issue where the final hit of Erel Light's skill Eternal Guardian did not trigger properly.
July 22, 2026
Resolved an issue where players were unable to enter Ride or Die through the Libae NPC.

2026年7月22日  
V.270 已知问题  

已知问题部分主要聚焦于对游戏和社区造成重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的主要问题。请注意，虽然我们力求涵盖最具影响力的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看，以了解这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题信息，或任何新增问题。  

以下为v.270“驾驭闪电”更新中已知及已解决的问题列表：

- “生死时速”硬币商店将暂时关闭，直至另行通知。  
- “行动：潜水记录”商店将暂时关闭，直至另行通知。

MAINTENANCE
Jul 23, 2026
[COMPLETED] UNSCHEDULED CHANNEL MAINTENANCE - JULY 23, 2026

[Updated 3:20 PM PDT] The channel maintenance has been completed. Thank you for your patience.

We will be performing an unscheduled channel maintenance today, July 23, 2026 at 1:00 PM PDT (4:00 PM EDT / 10:00 PM CEST / 6:00 AM AEST July 24). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2.5 hours, concluding around 3:30 PM PDT (6:30 PM EDT / 12:30 AM CEST July 24 / 8:30 AM AEST July 24).

Times:

Thursday, July 23, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 1:00 PM - 3:30 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 4:00 PM - 6:30 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 10:00 PM - 12:30 AM July 24
AEST (UTC +10): 6:00 AM July 24 - 8:30 AM July 24


What will be unavailable:

Group A

Channels 1-5, 11-15 on Luna and Solis
Channel 1-15 on Scania, Bera, and Hyperion
Channel 1-10 on NA Challenger World-Interactive
Channels 1-20 on Kronos
Channels 1-30 NA Challenger World-Heroic
Channel 1-5 on EU Challenger World-Interactive and EU Challenger World-Heroic
Cross World Party Quest
Group B

Please allow some time when moving between channels.
Channels 6-10, 16-20 on Luna and Solis
Channels 16-30 on Scania, Bera, and Hyperion
Channels 11-20 on NA Challenger World-Interactive
Channels 21-40 on Kronos
Channels 31-60 NA Challenger World-Heroic
Channel 6-10 on EU Challenger World-Interactive and EU Challenger World-Heroic

Changes and Updates:

Resolved an issue where the final hit of Erel Light's skill Eternal Guardian did not trigger properly.
Resolved an issue where Mystic Frontier Lineups were unable to be saved if it contained fewer than 3 Familiars.
Resolved an issue where Fever Time from the Beyond Hasty Hunting event would cause lag and sometimes disconnect players from the client.

Please restart your client once maintenance has been completed to ensure you receive the latest update.
